newsitem.title: MEXICO: Credit Lyonnais says GCC overpriced.
newsitem.headline: Credit Lyonnais says GCC overpriced.

text.p: Cement maker Grupo Cementos de Chihuahua's (GCC) shares are trading at high multiples that are not justifiable, especially when compared with Apasco, Credit Lyonnais brokerage said in a report.

"There is no justification for GCC to be trading at the same mulitple as Apasco. The latter is the cement company that probably stands to gain most from economic recovery," analyst Rafael Diaz said in a report.

Diaz reiterated his sell recommendation for GCC, adding that Apasco was not affected by anti-dumping tariffs on Mexican cement exports to the United States, as GCC was, and also enjoyed better operating margins.
